# RC-001 — Exact tree-level Schur complement and dimension-seven EOM reduction

**Status:** analytic tree-level reduction; no one-loop dimension-eight coefficient is claimed here. This note fixes the sign convention against the original UV Lagrangian and identifies the operators generated by the candidate \(M_E^{-3}\) term.

## 1. Frozen conventions

Take
\[
\mathcal L_E=\bar E(i\slashed D-M_E)E
-y_\ell\bar L_\ell H E_{\ell R}
-\lambda_\ell S_\ell\bar E_{\ell L}\ell_R+\mathrm{h.c.},
\qquad S_\mu=S,\quad S_\tau=S^*,
\]
with \(D_\mu=\partial_\mu+i\sum_a g_a A_\mu^a T^a\), so
\([D_\mu,D_\nu]=i\sum_a g_aF_{\mu\nu}^aT^a\).
The EFT convention is
\[
\mathcal L_{\rm EFT}\supset -C_{5,\ell}\mathcal O_{5,\ell}+\mathrm{h.c.},
\quad
\mathcal O_{5,\ell}=(\bar L_\ell H)S_\ell\ell_R,
\quad C_{5,\ell}=-\frac{y_\ell\lambda_\ell}{M_{E\ell}}.
\]

## 2. Exact Gaussian integration / Schur complement

Define the two heavy-spinor sources by
\[
\bar J_\ell=y_\ell\bar L_\ell H P_R,\qquad
J_\ell=\lambda_\ell P_R(S_\ell\ell_R)
\]
for the cross-chirality channel. Completing the square in
\(\bar E K E-\bar J E-\bar E J\), with \(K=i\slashed D-M_E\), gives
\[
\Delta\mathcal L_{\rm eff}=-\bar J K^{-1}J.
\]
Since \(P_R\slashed D P_R=0\),
\[
P_RK^{-1}P_R
=\frac{M_EP_R}{(i\slashed D)^2-M_E^2}
=-\frac{P_R}{M_E}
-\frac{P_R(i\slashed D)^2}{M_E^3}
+O(M_E^{-5}).
\]
Therefore the cross-chirality local action is
\[
\Delta\mathcal L_{\rm eff}^{\rm cross}
=+\frac{y_\ell\lambda_\ell}{M_{E\ell}}\mathcal O_{5,\ell}
+\frac{y_\ell\lambda_\ell}{M_{E\ell}^3}\mathcal O_{7,\ell}
+O(M_E^{-5})+\mathrm{h.c.},
\]
where
\[
\mathcal O_{7,\ell}
=(\bar L_\ell H)(i\slashed D)^2(S_\ell\ell_R).
\]
In the convention \(\mathcal L\supset-C_5\mathcal O_5-C_7\mathcal O_7\),
\[
\boxed{C_{7,\ell}=\frac{C_{5,\ell}}{M_{E\ell}^2}},
\qquad
\boxed{\Delta\mathcal L_{\rm EFT}^{(7)}
=-\frac{C_{5,\ell}}{M_{E\ell}^2}\mathcal O_{7,\ell}+\mathrm{h.c.}}
\]
This sign is fixed by the same Schur complement that gives
\(C_{5,\ell}=-y_\ell\lambda_\ell/M_{E\ell}\). In particular, writing
\(+C_5\mathcal O_7/M_E^2\) in the Lagrangian is a sign error.

The same exact Schur complement also gives the diagonal-source terms
\[
\Delta\mathcal L_{\rm eff}^{\rm diag}
=\frac{|y_\ell|^2}{M_{E\ell}^2}Q_{LD}
+\frac{|\lambda_\ell|^2}{M_{E\ell}^2}Q_{RD}
+\frac{|y_\ell|^2}{M_{E\ell}^4}Q_{LD}^{(8)}
+\frac{|\lambda_\ell|^2}{M_{E\ell}^4}Q_{RD}^{(8)}
+\cdots,
\]
with
\[
Q_{LD}=(\bar L_\ell H)i\slashed D(H^\dagger L_\ell),\quad
Q_{RD}=S_\ell^*\bar\ell_R i\slashed D(S_\ell\ell_R),
\]
\[
Q_{LD}^{(8)}=(\bar L_\ell H)(i\slashed D)^3(H^\dagger L_\ell),\quad
Q_{RD}^{(8)}=S_\ell^*\bar\ell_R(i\slashed D)^3(S_\ell\ell_R),
\]
where the derivative acts on the complete parenthesized source. The \(M_E^{-4}\) diagonal-source operators are tree-level dimension-eight insertions and must be included alongside double insertions of \(Q_{LD},Q_{RD}\) in a complete \(M_E^{-4}\) soft expansion.

## 3. Covariant derivative identity and light-field EOM

With the stated \(D_\mu\) convention,
\[
(i\slashed D)^2=-D^2-\frac12\sum_a g_a\sigma^{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}^aT^a,
\qquad \sigma^{\mu\nu}=\frac{i}{2}[\gamma^\mu,\gamma^\nu].
\]
For the product source this gives
\[
(i\slashed D)^2(S_\ell\ell_R)
=-(D^2S_\ell)\ell_R
-2(D_\mu S_\ell)D^\mu\ell_R
-S_\ell D^2\ell_R
-\frac12\sum_a g_a\sigma^{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}^a(S_\ell\ell_R).
\]
The leading renormalizable light-field equation in the frozen \(\mu,\tau\) sector is
\(i\slashed D\ell_R=0\); the ordinary charged-lepton Yukawa is absent. Applying the same squared-Dirac identity to \(\ell_R\) gives
\[
D^2\ell_R=-\frac12\sum_a g_a\sigma^{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}^aT^a_{\ell_R}\ell_R.
\]
Substitution cancels the field-strength action on the \(\ell_R\) factor, leaving the field-strength action on the scalar factor:
\[
(i\slashed D)^2(S_\ell\ell_R)
=-(D^2S_\ell)\ell_R
-2(D_\mu S_\ell)D^\mu\ell_R
-\frac12\sum_a g_a\sigma^{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}^a(T^a_{S_\ell}S_\ell)\ell_R,
\]
where the last term is present only for gauge groups under which \(S_\ell\) is charged. For SM gauge groups \(S_\ell\) is a singlet; for \(U(1)_{L_\mu-L_\tau}\) it is generally charged and the term must be retained. This displays why the candidate dimension-seven operator is not identically zero when the ordinary \(\ell_R\) Yukawa vanishes: derivatives act on \(S_\ell\), and the \(U(1)_X\) field-strength term can remain.

## 4. Dimension-six operators and current-basis EOM reduction

At leading order, \(i\slashed D L_\ell=0\) and \(i\slashed D\ell_R=0\) in the frozen charged-lepton sector. Thus, modulo the leading fermion EOM,
\[
Q_{LD}\doteq iH_i(D_\mu H_j^\dagger)\,
(\bar L_{\ell i}\gamma^\mu L_{\ell j}),
\qquad
Q_{RD}\doteq iS_\ell^*(D_\mu S_\ell)
(\bar\ell_R\gamma^\mu\ell_R).
\]
The symbol \(\doteq\) denotes equality modulo EOM and total derivatives, not equality of off-shell Green-basis operators. Decompose each scalar derivative into its Hermitian-current and total-derivative pieces:
\[
iS^*D_\mu S
=\frac{i}{2}S^*\overleftrightarrow D_\mu S
+\frac{i}{2}D_\mu(S^*S).
\]
The second term can be integrated by parts into the divergence of the corresponding fermion current. It vanishes only when the relevant leading EOM/current conservation identity is applicable; it must be kept in the off-shell Green basis until that step is justified. The analogous Higgs expression requires the full weak-index singlet/triplet decomposition; it must not be projected onto a singlet current alone.

## 5. Consequence for the \(Q_{LD}Q_{RD}\) soft topology

In the unbroken, massless EFT with the ordinary \(\bar L H\ell_R\) Yukawa absent, the free propagators are block diagonal:
\[
\langle L_\ell\bar\ell_R\rangle=0.
\]
A single fermion loop with one \(Q_{LD}\) insertion and one \(Q_{RD}\) insertion therefore cannot be closed: the \(Q_{LD}\) vertex contains only \(L_\ell,\bar L_\ell\), whereas \(Q_{RD}\) contains only \(\ell_R,\bar\ell_R\). The mixed two-insertion contraction factorizes into separate fermion loops and is not a connected one-loop four-scalar 1PI graph. A connected contribution requires an additional chirality-changing interaction/insertion (for example a \(C_5\) insertion after symmetry breaking), which changes the heavy-mass order and must be counted separately. Consequently the previously listed one-loop \(Q_{LD}Q_{RD}\) mixed four-scalar topology is **not admissible at strict \(M_E^{-4}\)** in the stated massless unbroken EFT. This conclusion must be revisited only if the EFT field content or renormalizable Yukawa interactions are changed.

## 6. Acceptance boundary

The Schur-complement sign, formal propagator expansion, diagonal \(Q_{LD}/Q_{RD}\) expansion, and the absence of the strict one-loop mixed \(Q_{LD}Q_{RD}\) contraction follow analytically from the frozen UV/EFT field content. The full nonredundant dimension-seven basis still requires the complete integration-by-parts/EOM/source ledger, including the scalar EOM, \(U(1)_X\) charge conventions, and any generated current/source operators. No one-loop dimension-eight soft coefficient is claimed in this note.
